next_steps.title: Representation-learning feasibility gate
next_steps.purpose: Decide whether fixed engineered EEG/EMG features are exhausted and define raw/learned representation experiments.
next_steps.success_condition: A learned EEG/EMG representation beats fixed-feature physiology under the same locked gates.

next_steps.title: Targeted arousal high-disagreement gating refinement
next_steps.purpose: Use the confirmed arousal EEG-bandpower high-disagreement signal as a risk/gating signal rather than direct additive correction.
next_steps.success_condition: A gating or uncertainty-aware model improves high-disagreement arousal without degrading locked personalization.

next_steps.title: Cross-dataset physiology representation sanity check
next_steps.purpose: Check whether current DEAP fixed-feature bottleneck is dataset/representation-specific by using another affective physiology dataset if available.
